verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs confirm it uses JavaScript source maps so stack traces show the original filename, line number, method name and code coordinates (rollbar-docs-5, rollbar-docs-27). The pack never says how source maps are supplied: there is no CI upload workflow, CLI or bundler plugin. That leaves the delivery half of the story unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented CI upload via CLI, a bundler plugin (webpack/Vite etc.), and independent or hands-on corroboration of symbolication working.
